name: PartWerx Automotive
old_description: When drivers in Durham are looking for an estimate on auto parts they call PartWerx Automotive. Since 2017, PartWerx Automotive has been delivering competitively priced auto parts to the Durham area.
about:
PartWerx Automotive is headquartered in Garner, North Carolina, and was established in 2017 to address a gap in the market for a quality-focused distributor of aftermarket auto body parts that also delivered exceptional service in the Garner area. The company operates from 1035 N Greenfield Parkway and serves collision repair shops across a wide swath of central North Carolina.

The business distributes aftermarket auto body parts at competitive prices and runs an online store where collision shop owners can create accounts, browse inventory, purchase parts, and have them delivered directly. PartWerx closed its Charlotte location but continues to deliver throughout the Raleigh, Greensboro, and surrounding regions, including Garner, Clayton, Durham, Harrisburg, Lincolnton, Denver, Mooresville, Monroe, Albemarle, Concord-Kannapolis, Shelby, Gastonia, and Salisbury.

Its customers are primarily auto body collision repair shops, ranging from multi-shop operators to independent local body shops. The company emphasizes that it understands the collision repair business and the urgency of getting vehicles back on the road safely and quickly.

PartWerx was started because the founders saw a strong need for a provider that combined quality aftermarket parts with outstanding service. Their motto, "Outstanding Quality - Exceptional Service," reflects a stated focus on responsiveness and reliability rather than scale.
